caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spoon rendered in pencil on a cream-colored rectangular sheet of paper. The spoon is positioned diagonally from the upper left to the lower right within a rectangular border drawn near the edges of the page. The handle of the spoon, in the upper left, contains an ornate monogram with the letters "M.C.P." written in decorative script. The body of the spoon is shaded to indicate its concave shape, and there is a subtle shadow cast below and to the left of the spoon, suggesting a light source from the upper right. The overall color of the drawing is monochromatic, consisting of various shades of gray created by graphite on off-white paper. The artist's signature appears in the lower right margin just outside the border.
title: Silver Teaspoon
